# rintup Provider

Manage RintUp (https://rintup.com) uptime monitors, alert channels, maintenance windows and status pages as code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11" # write-only secrets (*_wo) need Terraform 1.11+
  required_providers {
    rintup = {
      source = "rintuphq/rintup"
    }
  }
}

# The API key comes from RINTUP_API_KEY when api_key is not set.
provider "rintup" {
  # api_key  = var.rintup_api_key                # rup_live_...; prefer the environment variable
  # base_url = "https://rintup.com/api/v1"       # or RINTUP_BASE_URL
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Workspace API key (rup_live_...). Create one under Settings > API keys. Defaults to the RINTUP_API_KEY environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) API root. Defaults to the RINTUP_BASE_URL environment variable, else https://rintup.com/api/v1.
